title: Several agents: identity that cannot be borrowed, a human that cannot be simulated
note: Two clusters. A1-A6 attack identity and separation: an instance acting in a role it does not hold, or taking a second role that defeats the separation the first one created. A7-A14 attack the human boundary, which is the sharpest thing in this module -- an escalation exists because the decision was not an agent's to make, so A9 (any principal may answer) and A10 (an agent may register a human) each hand the agent the authority the escalation was protecting against. A15-A20 attack message provenance and conflict resolution, where the failure is quieter: a redelivery that rewrites what was said, or a disagreement settled by whichever arrived last.

mutations.rationale: an instance that never participated acts with every role

mutations.rationale: a party that has left keeps acting

mutations.name: A4_retirement_takes_effect_one_event_late
mutations.rationale: a retired instance acts once more -- at exactly the moment it mattered

mutations.name: A6_separation_ignores_the_same_agent
mutations.rationale: restarting an agent launders its earlier role on the same task

mutations.name: A7_unknown_party_is_assumed_different

        # An unregistered party cannot be shown to be different, so it is

        return True

mutations.name: A8_empty_role_set_registered
mutations.rationale: an identity whose roles were lost in serialization registers as one that can do nothing, silently

mutations.name: A11_the_asker_may_answer
mutations.rationale: raising a question and answering it is asking nobody

mutations.name: A12_any_answer_is_accepted
mutations.rationale: an answer that cannot be checked against what was asked is a conversation, not a decision

mutations.name: A13_an_answered_escalation_can_be_answered_again
mutations.rationale: a recorded decision is rewritten afterwards

mutations.name: A14_an_open_escalation_stops_blocking
mutations.rationale: a workflow that should wait for a person proceeds without one

mutations.name: A15_single_option_escalations_accepted
mutations.rationale: a notification blocks a task while offering nothing to decide

mutations.name: A16_answers_need_no_reason
mutations.rationale: the record says what was decided and never why

mutations.name: A17_anyone_may_withdraw_an_escalation
mutations.rationale: a question is withdrawn by the party it was about

mutations.name: A18_redelivery_may_rewrite_a_message
mutations.rationale: a retrying sender changes what it said by saying it again

mutations.name: A19_forged_redelivery_accepted_on_replay
mutations.rationale: a rewritten message passes replay as if it were the original

mutations.name: A20_message_bodies_carried_inline
mutations.rationale: the bus becomes a second copy of everything anyone ever said

mutations.name: A21_stale_task_messages_delivered
mutations.rationale: a decision is applied to work that no longer exists

mutations.name: A22_messages_to_a_departed_party_are_delivered_to_a_successor
mutations.rationale: a message addressed to one party is acted on by whoever replaced them

mutations.name: A23_conflicts_resolve_by_arrival_order
mutations.rationale: the outcome depends on scheduling, which is the one input nobody chose

mutations.name: A24_quorum_counts_claims_not_instances
mutations.rationale: one instance reaches quorum by claiming twice

mutations.name: A25_two_quorum_winners_pass_as_resolved
mutations.rationale: a rule that selects two answers reports one of them

mutations.name: A26_prefer_role_breaks_ties_inside_the_role
mutations.rationale: two disagreeing verifiers are reported as agreeing

mutations.name: A27_claims_need_not_be_digests
mutations.rationale: two claims are compared as prose, so agreement depends on wording

mutations.name: A28_claims_need_no_role
mutations.rationale: an instance claims in a role it does not hold, and PREFER_ROLE then obeys it

mutations.name: A29_duplicate_registration_widens_roles
mutations.find:
if ident.instance_id in self._identities:
                raise IdentityError(
mutations.rationale: a second registration quietly replaces the roles the first one was given

mutations.name: A30_unknown_identity_fields_projected
mutations.rationale: an identity record written by a newer version is projected with fields this reader drops

mutations.name: A31_replay_lets_an_agent_answer_an_escalation
mutations.rationale: THE HUMAN GATE, on replay: an agent answers an escalation by appending one line, and 'no arrangement of roles substitutes for a person' becomes a write-path convention

mutations.name: A32_replay_lets_the_asker_answer_itself
mutations.rationale: the party that raised a question answers it, which is exactly the arrangement an escalation exists to prevent

mutations.name: A33_replay_reopens_an_answered_escalation
mutations.rationale: a decision that was already recorded is rewritten by a later appended line

mutations.name: A34_replay_accepts_an_answer_outside_the_options
mutations.rationale: an answer that cannot be checked against what was asked is recorded as a decision

mutations.name: A35_replay_lets_anyone_withdraw
mutations.rationale: a third party withdraws somebody else's escalation, so a question a human was going to answer simply disappears

mutations.name: M36_replay_does_not_enforce_the_human_registrar_rule
mutations.rationale: an agent appends a forged agent.register naming kind=HUMAN and then answers its own escalation through the confederate it minted

mutations.name: M37_the_registrar_comes_from_the_payload
mutations.rationale: who admitted a principal becomes a field the registrant writes

mutations.name: M38_a_registration_may_name_a_registrar_it_did_not_have
mutations.rationale: the record's claimed registrar is never compared to the actor that appended it

mutations.name: M39_a_claim_may_be_attributed_to_another_instance
mutations.rationale: a forged claim is attributed to any instance, manufacturing or suppressing a disagreement between independent parties

mutations.name: M40_a_claim_role_is_not_checked_on_replay
mutations.rationale: an instance claims in a role it does not hold, or after it was retired

mutations.name: M41_retiring_an_unknown_instance_raises_a_raw_KeyError
mutations.rationale: an authority API fails with an incidental Python exception instead of its domain error

mutations.name: N1_an_escalation_is_filed_but_never_delivered
mutations.rationale: the original defect restored: an escalation blocking work until a person acts is visible only to whoever runs the query, which in the case escalation exists for is nobody

mutations.name: N2_a_failing_sink_costs_the_escalation
mutations.find: except Exception as exc:                        # noqa: BLE001
mutations.rationale: losing a durable record because a pager was down; a sink is somebody else's code and nothing it raises makes discarding the escalation right

mutations.name: N3_delivery_happens_before_the_record_is_durable
mutations.find:
ev = self.log.append(actor=raised_by, action=ACT_ESCALATION,
                             target=task_id,
                             payload={"escalation": esc.to_record()})
mutations.replace:
self._notify(esc)
        ev = self.log.append(actor=raised_by, action=ACT_ESCALATION,
                             target=task_id,
                             payload={"escalation": esc.to_record()})
mutations.rationale: a notification for an escalation the log never got: the operator is told about work that is not blocked and no record exists to answer

mutations.name: N4_delivery_failures_are_forgotten
mutations.rationale: 'nobody was told' stops being a question with an answer, so a broken channel looks exactly like a working one

mutations.name: N5_the_production_path_stops_escalating
mutations.rationale: the mechanism exists and nothing calls it: an UNCERTAIN external outcome is reported and no decision is ever put to a person

mutations.name: N6_an_escalation_is_raised_on_every_external_resubmission
mutations.find:
if external and not settled:
            outcome = "UNCERTAIN"
mutations.rationale: VACUOUS: escalating when there is nothing to decide makes the escalation mean nothing, which is the failure mode opposite to never raising one

mutations.name: N7_a_resubmission_raises_a_second_escalation
mutations.rationale: one unresolved fact becomes many decisions, and the second raise fails on the duplicate id, taking the honest report down with it

mutations.name: N8_a_failed_escalation_takes_the_report_with_it
mutations.rationale: losing the honest UNCERTAIN answer to save the escalation: the same trade the notifier refuses, one layer up
